subtitle.en: A vocabulary platform for Secondary Chinese Language

summary.en: 3,741 vocabulary items across G1, G2, G3 and Higher Chinese, with visible progression, streaks and student-selected challenge. The core learning mechanics were designed around Self-Determination Theory and Assessment for Learning from the outset.
summary.zh: 3,741 个词条，涵盖 G1、G2、G3 与高级华文，有看得见的进度、连续挑战，难度由学生自己选。核心的学习机制，一开始就是照着自我决定理论（SDT）与促进学习的评价（AfL）来设计的。

highlight.en: Built without formal software-engineering training, in conversation with an AI coding agent (Claude Code), on a Firebase backend. The scene artwork was generated with ChatGPT; the vocabulary bank was vetted by hand, entry by entry.
highlight.zh: 没有受过软件工程的正规训练，全程与 AI 编程 agent（Claude Code）协作，后端用 Firebase。场景插图由 ChatGPT 生成；词库则逐条人工审核。

summary.en: A platformer that teaches Secondary 3 G3 students to spot argumentation techniques in two set texts. Six lives instead of three, so an unfamiliar game mechanic is less likely to be the reason a student stops.
summary.zh: 一个横向卷轴游戏，教中三 G3 学生认出两篇课文里的论证法。生命值给六条不是三条：不熟悉操作，不该成为学生放弃的理由。

summary.en: I asked a student what he does when he gets stuck in Chinese class. He shrugged: “stare into space?”, with an iPad already in his hands. The hub turns that device into somewhere to go next: SLS resources by subject level and year, past oral exam videos by topic, reading and listening practice, graded reading, and a glossary for the Singapore terms no dictionary carries. Colleagues now add to it.
summary.zh: 我问一个学生：华文课上卡住了，你会做什么？他耸耸肩说「发呆？」，手里正拿着 iPad。资源站就是要让那台设备变成他下一步可以去的地方：按科目程度与年级整理的 SLS 资源、按主题分类的历年会话考试录像、朗读与听力练习、分级泛读，还有一份字典查不到的新加坡本地词汇表。同事现在也一起在加东西。

title.zh: 单元五复习《学无止境》· 书山登顶

summary.en: A drag-and-drop revision game for Secondary 3 G3. Both texts in the unit run on argument by contrast, but in opposite orders: one negative then positive, the other positive then negative. That reversal is what the closing screen points out. A wrong card springs back and costs nothing, so every student finishes, but the mark records the first judgement, which is what makes the figure in the SLS gradebook worth reading.
summary.zh: 为中三 G3 做的拖曳式复习游戏。单元里两篇课文用的都是对比论证，顺序却相反：一篇先反后正，一篇先正后反 —— 收关时才点破，这个对调本身就是学习点。放错的卡片弹回原位，不扣分，所以人人走得完；但分数记的是第一次的判断，SLS 教师后台那个数字才有诊断价值。
